name: Civic Cookie Control
description: Enables you to comply with UK and EU law on cookies
library_dependencies: Civic Cookie Control widget JS (external, https://cc.cdn.civiccomputing.com/8/ and /9/)
jQuery MiniColors (external CDN, admin form only)
project_description: Civic Cookie Control integrates the CivicUK Cookie Control consent widget into Drupal so a site can comply with the UK PECR and EU GDPR cookie rules. The module does not implement the consent engine itself: it loads Civic's hosted JavaScript from cc.cdn.civiccomputing.com and feeds it a JSON configuration object built from Drupal configuration and config entities. Administrators enter a Civic API key (a public, domain-locked site key) and product/licence type, then customise the widget's text, branding, accessibility, statement, CCPA notice and IAB TCF v2 vendor settings. Optional-cookie categories, strictly-necessary cookies, excluded countries and alternative-language translations are stored as config entities and injected into the widget config. An optional submodule provides a GOV.UK Design System styled banner block for public-sector (DWP) services.
